title: Duke and the Cube
lines: Ben has one cute mule, Duke.
Once, Duke sat in the dust.
He will not get up at all.
"Up, Duke!" said Ben. Duke just sits.
Ben gets a tube with a cube in it.
He hums a tune and lifts up the cube.
Duke gets up fast and grabs the cube.
Then they step up the path and go home.

questions.ask: What does Duke do when Ben tells him to get up?
questions.listenFor: Nothing — he just sits. The line says "Duke just sits."

questions.ask: What finally gets Duke up on his feet?
questions.listenFor: The cube from the tube. If they say "the tune", that is close — ask what Ben was holding up.

questions.ask: What do you think Ben will take next time? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. Listen for something like "a cube, because that is what worked."
